honesty.readiness_only_label: offline conformance is a READINESS signal only: never live evidence, earns no §18.1 row, earns no §18.3 claim, does not unlock L-3, and does not authorise a live run (SI-76 §3.6)
honesty.capture_note: live_attempts counts the offline scoring step only (§3.4); the corpus itself was captured by live gateway calls to the already-running local node — counted in the capture section of the SI-79 slice doc; capture admitted no intent, executed no tool, and wrote no gate verdict
